items.followUp: How does mitosis help in the growth of an organism?

rubric.why: Mitosis is the cell division process involved in regeneration.
rubric.description: Identifies mitosis as the process involved.

rubric.why: The new cells replace lost or damaged cells, helping restore the body part.
rubric.description: Explains how the new cells contribute to regeneration.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that new cells replace lost or damaged cells or restore the body part.

modelAnswer: Mitosis produces new cells at the site of injury or loss.
These cells replace damaged or lost cells and help regenerate the body part.
